textRuns.value: Top 5 parent categories, 21 May 2018 onward — categories were not recorded before then. An incident with two categories counts once in each bar; do not add the bars together.

Weekly chart: last completed month on the reported date, weeks are days 1-7, 8-14, 15-21 and 22 to month end. It counts incident-category pairs, so an incident with two categories appears in both. Top 4 categories each week, the rest plus Other and Unknown go into Others.
